name: EPIC 248581467
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 10.4 solar radii and 0.76 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 6,541 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.76 solar masses and 10.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,913 K at its surface.
